# superseded by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:supersededBy`](gmeow-supersededBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/supersededBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lifecycle`](../../slices/lifecycle.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links an entity to the entity that replaced it — Constantinople [`supersededBy`](gmeow-supersededBy.md) Istanbul, the Soviet Union [`supersededBy`](gmeow-supersededBy.md) the Russian Federation, a deprecated software release [`supersededBy`](gmeow-supersededBy.md) its successor. Directional, NOT symmetric. The superseded entity is retained (never deleted) and may carry [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:supersededBy`](gmeow-supersededBy.md) from [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Dissolved Org

- **Source:** [`slices/core/lifecycle/examples/dissolved-org.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/lifecycle/examples/dissolved-org.ttl)

```turtle
# --- The dissolved company: still here, with its full lifecycle attached.
#     Superseded AND no longer extant, so gmeow:displayable false suppresses it
#     from default display — the record is retained, never deleted (P10).
ex:meridian a gmeow:Organization ;
    gmeow:name "Meridian Systems Ltd."@en ;
    gmeow:hasCreationEvent ex:founding ;
    gmeow:hasDestructionEvent ex:dissolution ;
    gmeow:existenceInterval ex:meridianLife ;
    gmeow:supersededBy ex:apex ;
    gmeow:displayable false .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a retired entity forward to the entity that replaced it — a renamed place, a successor state, a deprecated release — preserving the predecessor rather than deleting it ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating it as symmetric (it is directional; the inverse is [`gmeow:supersedes`](gmeow-supersedes.md)) and avoid deleting the superseded entity — retain it, link it forward, and mark [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false if it should drop out of projections.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:supersededBy`](gmeow-supersededBy.md) from predecessor to successor; optionally record the change itself as a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) typed [`gmeow:eventTypeSupersession`](../individuals/gmeow-eventTypeSupersession.md), and mark the predecessor [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false for forward-facing projections.
